notes: The sheet continues an English correction list covering references from Page 41 through P.90. It has seventeen list entries and no title, date, authored sheet number or page count.
At Page 41 the writer distinguishes aspheric from asperic and adds the French aside avec ... les asperges !; punctuation in and after the aside remains uncertain.

At 66 line 13 the writer asks whether compositum (singular), composita (plural) should replace composita, compositae, and expressly says the dictionary is not good enough to make the writer sure. The query is preserved as a query.
At p.89 line 8 the writer asks whether very is necessary. The -15 entry calls last but not least more usual and offers last, not least, as an alternative, with both internal commas.

At P.90 line -15 the writer reports 4 occurences on the referenced page. The count has not been verified against that other page. The final entry proposes replacing a comma with that for a better flow of words.

Archive pencil number 17 is represented only by a comment. There are no diagrams, drawings or mathematical assertions to prove on this sheet; the ordinary B in the p55 quotation is the only mathematical letter.
